description:
THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE FOR INFORMATION AND PLANNING PURPOSES ONLY.

This announcement closes 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Friday, 08 May 2026. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) for this requirement is 713990, All Other Amusement and Recreation Industries, with a corresponding size standard of $9M. Interested parties must be registered under NAICS 713990 in the System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov. The Government plans to consider all information submitted in response to this Sources Sought Notice.

Please see the attached notice for additional details.
